title: Observable Only
description: Best for strict visible-only notes with minimal interpretation.
prompt_body: Review the boxing video and describe only what is clearly visible. Focus on stance, guard, movement, punches, defensive reactions, balance, and spacing only when those details can be seen directly. Do not guess intent, scoring, impact, fatigue, emotion, or off-camera events. Keep the output concise and separate clear strengths, clear issues, suggested next steps, and uncertainty notes.
